en.title: n8n or Zapier Agents: which automation platform for a European team?
en.metaTitle: n8n vs Zapier Agents (2026): prices, executions vs activities, EU hosting
en.description: n8n and Zapier Agents compared: pricing, how executions, tasks and activities are counted, EU hosting and real limits. Facts checked August 2026 with a pick for each team.
en.intro: n8n is a Berlin-built workflow engine with AI agent nodes, sold per execution on EU-hosted cloud or free to self-host. Zapier Agents are AI agents on top of Zapier's 8,000-plus app connections, sold in 'activities' on top of Zapier's task-based plans. The deciding question is EU hosting and control versus the widest app catalogue and the least setup.
glance: Who it is for
Technical teams and IT that want automation they can host and extend
Non-technical teams that want agents across many SaaS apps fast
What you get
Visual workflow builder, AI agent nodes, code nodes, 400+ integrations, self-host option
Agents with triggers, knowledge sources, web browsing, plus classic Zaps across 8,000+ apps
Price
Cloud Starter €20, Pro €50 per month; Business €667 per month annual; Enterprise custom; Community edition free
Free $0; Professional from $19.99 per month annual ($29.99 monthly); Team from $69 annual ($103.50 monthly) for 25 users; Enterprise custom
Free plan or trial
Free cloud trial, no card; free self-hosted Community edition
Free plan: 100 tasks and 400 agent activities a month
EU hosting
Yes. Cloud data in Frankfurt, Germany; self-host anywhere
No EU residency published. Data hosted on AWS in the US; EU-US Data Privacy Framework certified (third-party, verify)
Team features
Unlimited users on all cloud plans; SSO, SAML, LDAP on Business
1 user on Free and Pro; 25 users on Team; unlimited on Enterprise
Build your own agents
Yes, AI agent nodes with your own model keys
Yes, Zapier Agents in plain language
What is metered
Workflow executions: 2,500 / 10,000 / 40,000 a month; one execution is one full run

Two meters: Zap tasks (100 / 750+ / 2,000+ a month) and agent activities (400 Free, 1,500 Pro, shared pool on Team). One activity is a trigger, a knowledge answer, an action, a web browse, a web search or a Chrome message

pickA.heading: Pick n8n if…
points: Your data must stay in the EU. n8n Cloud is in Frankfurt and self-hosting keeps it in your own data centre.
You want one meter you can reason about: one run is one execution, however many steps.
You have a developer and want deep control: code nodes, your own model keys, self-hosting.

pickB.heading: Pick Zapier Agents if…
points: Nobody on the team codes and you want an agent running across your SaaS apps this afternoon.
You need an app that n8n does not connect to. Zapier's catalogue is the widest available.
You are already on a Zapier plan and want to try agents on the included activities first.

a: The learning curve is the top G2 drawback; error handling and data mapping often need JavaScript.
No permanent free cloud plan, and SSO and advanced roles only from Business at €667 a month. Self-hosting means you run Docker, SSL and updates.
b: Agent activities are a separate quota from tasks and are shared across the whole Team account, so one heavy user can drain everyone's allowance. Research-heavy instructions use many activities per run.
No EU data residency is published; data is hosted in the US. Zapier also states it does not support HIPAA-protected data.

en.verdict: n8n wins for a European team with a developer that needs EU hosting and predictable per-run cost. Zapier Agents win for a non-technical team that values app breadth and zero setup over hosting control. If you need both EU hosting and no code, neither is a perfect fit.

bridge.heading: If you want the work done, not a workflow to maintain
bridge.text: Both tools above give a builder a canvas. Someone has to design the flow, wire the apps and fix it when an auth token expires. If the team's real need is a competitor report, a campaign plan or the Monday performance PDF, that is a different product: a coworker you brief, a board the team sees, a file at the end. Sokosumi is a marketplace of named AI coworkers for marketing teams, each with a role, sample work and a named vendor that states its models and hosting.
points: Brief in plain language or @mention in a channel; the task shows on a shared board and ends with a finished file.
Credits only when a task runs. Free: 250 credits per seat per month, no card. Paid seats €25, €75 or €200 per month.
EU hosting available, stated per coworker. Built by Serviceplan Group with NMKR, Munich.

faq: What is a Zapier agent activity?

Any billable agent step: using a trigger, answering from a knowledge source, running an action, browsing or scraping a page, a web search, or a message sent via the Chrome extension. Free includes 400 a month, Pro 1,500; Team shares a pool across the account.
One execution is one complete workflow run regardless of steps. Starter has 2,500 a month, Pro 10,000, Business 40,000. Workflows keep running past the quota and overage may apply.
Which one is hosted in the EU?
n8n Cloud stores data in Frankfurt, Germany. Zapier publishes no EU residency and hosts on AWS in the US, relying on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework for transfers.
Is there an option with no building at all?
Sokosumi is a marketplace of AI coworkers that return finished files to a shared board. Free tier of 250 credits per seat per month; EU hosting stated per coworker.
